title: The Robot Demonstration
question: 把今天“走进危险区域 -> 没意识到危险 -> 看到移动物体 -> 笨拙闪开 -> 学会安全边界”的表达，放进 school robotics demonstration 场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: During a school robotics demonstration, I wandered into the middle of the demonstration area. At first, I was unaware of the danger. The robot suddenly caught sight of an obstacle near me and moved towards it. I clumsily stepped aside, and my teacher pulled me to safety. Next time, I will stay behind the safety line.
